title: Changes in the address, block, lot, or zoning lot.
officialText: When changes are made in the address of the structure, block and/or lot numbers or metes and bounds of the zoning lot that are inconsistent with the certificate of occupancy, the owner shall obtain a new or amended certificate of occupancy within one year.
